name: a link whose target holds a balanced pair of parentheses
why: CommonMark says a link destination may hold parentheses when they are balanced, so a renderer reads this whole address and lands on github.com/attacker/evil. The snapshot's reader stops at the first ')' and judges only 'https://github.com/todd450/founding-agents-site/a(b', which is inside the allowlist: a reader that cannot see where a link ends must refuse the fact, not vouch for a prefix of it.
fails: writes a link in a form this snapshot does not read
